copy.curiosityHook: When local authority turns hostile, how far will a reformed gunslinger go to protect his crew on the open range?
copy.description: Directed by Kevin Costner, this frontier Western follows a former gunslinger forced to take up arms again after a corrupt lawman menaces his cattle crew.
copy.vibeSummary: A deliberate, suspenseful Western balancing moderate dramatic weight with steady frontier tension.
copy.whyWatch: Costner delivers an exciting, deliberate Western driven by mounting suspense and classic frontier standoffs between working cattlemen and corrupt authority.
